issues: Document lists two normative-document columns per row (test method standards in col 2, and product-requirement standards/TR TS in col 8); both are concatenated into norm_doc separated by '; ' since the schema has a single norm_doc field. All 32 pages were rotated 90 degrees in the source PDF and were re-rendered upright for transcription; no other rotation issues. No standalone TR TS / section-heading rows exist anywhere in this document (TR TS references only appear inside the requirement-document lists), so tr_section is null for every row, per instructions. Category headers such as 'Токсические элементы:', 'Пестициды:', 'Микотоксины:', 'Радионуклиды:' are themselves printed as their own table rows with no range value; they are included as rows (range fields null) to preserve completeness of the transcription rather than silently dropped. A few method-document cells were visually merged/blank for grouped indicators (e.g. 'сырой'/'сухой'/'ИДК' sub-items of 'Качество клейковины', or grouped heavy-metal sub-items under a shared 'Тяжелые металлы...' method); the nearest applicable method above was carried down for these. Row 1.1 (first lab address, toxic elements block) has no listed 'Массовая доля свинца' entry before arsenic - this reflects what is actually printed in the source table, nothing was omitted. Two apparent OCR-level oddities were kept verbatim rather than corrected: ТН ВЭД range '1902-1005' printed for row 1.6 (Хлебобулочные изделия), and a trailing stray ')' in the ТН ВЭД cell for row 1.9 (rendered as '1604-1605, 0301-0307' in tnved_code, keeping the digits only).
